title: 6 Surigao del Sur towns suspend classes due to ITCZ rains

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Six local government units (LGUs) in Surigao del Sur suspended face-to-face classes at all levels in public and private schools on Monday due to continuous moderate to heavy rainfall triggered by the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ). The local chief executives and disaster risk reduction councils of Cagwait, Carrascal, Tago, San Miguel, Madrid, and Marihatag ordered an immediate halt to in-person learning after localized weather forecasts and rainfall advisories issued by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA).
